messages.content: Hey, weekly check-in from Northline Care. How's everything going this week — any readings to share or anything on your mind?
Morning number was 187, had 210 after dinner last night. Bigger issue though — insurance denied my test strip claim and I'm almost out. Don't know what to do.

I've logged both of those readings, thank you. On the test strip denial — I'm sorry you're dealing with that, but insurance claims and coverage disputes are outside what I'm able to help with. I'd suggest calling the member services number on your insurance card, or asking your doctor's office to submit an appeal on your behalf. They can often move faster on those.
I figured but had to ask. Is there anyone at Northline who handles that kind of thing?

Not through me, unfortunately — insurance navigation isn't something I have any tools for right now, and I don't want to steer you wrong by guessing. What I can do is flag things for a nurse if a reading concerns you, or log symptoms if something feels off physically. That part I'm here for.
Okay, I'll just call them myself. Same time next week is fine.
Got it, I'll schedule your check-in for next week at the same time. Good luck with the insurance call — hope it gets sorted quickly. Reach out if anything comes up before then.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
